'''Bone Weapon Proficiency''', also known as '''Bone Atk. Up''', and '''Bone Weap. Prof.''', is a recurring [[Set Bonus]] in {{TLoZ Series}}.

==Overview==
==={{BotW|-}}===
Bone Atk. Up is a [[Set Bonus]] that increases the attack power of bone [[Weapon]]s and [[Bow]]s by 80%. This boost stacks multiplicatively with the [[Attack Up]] [[Added Effect|Effect]]. The following Weapons are considered to be bone Weapons or Bows in {{BotW}}:

{{Icon List|BotW|
 * Bokoblin Arm
 * Dragonbone Boko Bat
 * Dragon Bone Boko Bow
 * Dragonbone Boko Club
 * Dragonbone Boko Spear
 * Dragonbone Moblin Club
 * Dragonbone Moblin Spear
 * Lizal Bow
 * Lizalfos Arm
 * Moblin Arm
 * Spiked Boko Bow
 * Spiked Boko Club
 * Spiked Boko Spear
 * Spiked Moblin Club
 * Spiked Moblin Spear
}}

Bone Atk. Up is granted by the [[Radiant Attire]] (★★) and the [[Evil Spirit Set|Phantom Ganon Set]].

==={{TotK|-}}===
In {{TotK}}, Bone Weapon Proficiency is a [[Set Bonus]] that increases the attack power of bone [[Equipment]] by 80%, stacking multiplicatively with the [[Attack Up]] [[Added Effect|Effect]]. The boost applies if either the base Equipment or the object [[Fuse]]d to it is made of bone, but it does not apply to bone [[Arrow]] fusions. The following Equipment and [[Object]]s are considered bone Equipment:

{{Icon List|TotK|
 * Bokoblin Arm
 * Dragonbone Boko Bow
 * Dragonbone Boko Shield
 * Gibdo Bone
 * Lizal Bow
 * Lizalfos Arm
 * Moblin Arm
 * Molduga Jaw
 * Spiked Boko Bow
 * Spiked Boko Shield
 * Spiny Bone
 * Stalnox Horn
}}

Bone Weapon Proficiency is granted by the [[Evil Spirit Set]] and the [[Radiant Attire]] (★★).
